# Version 4.150.8 (Unreleased)
> **Region and texture corrections**

## Highlights

The upcoming 4.150.8 servicing release corrects region buffer sizing and GPU texture handling in Skia m150.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Safe region sizing for conics** — Corrects scanline-transition allocation for subdivided conics in SkRegion::setPath and rejects accumulation overflow, preventing a heap out-of-bounds write. ([#5543](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5543))
- **Correct texture uploads and subset sampling** — Disables GLES-invalid RGBA uploads for BGRA textures interpreted as RGBx. Nearest-filtered texture subsets retain shader clamps where magnification or fractional mappings could sample neighboring texels, while preserving the touching-edge fast path for one-to-one integer-relative mappings. ([#5543](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5543))
